about.title: About
body: Technical manager with 15 years of experience leading development teams (up to 11 people) and shipping complex, high-traffic web applications. Symfony and Angular expert, I ensure product quality, performance and scalability while building a lasting DevOps and Agile culture.

My approach is grounded in open communication and proactive problem-solving. I run Scrum ceremonies, prioritise the product roadmap with stakeholders, and invest in my team — pair-programming, structured code reviews, individual growth plans.
Always keeping up with the latest in tech, I firmly believe that a product's quality depends as much on solid architecture as on the cohesion of the team that builds it.

items.summary: Led a cross-functional team of 11 developers (back-end, front-end, QA). Set up a full CI/CD pipeline cutting deployment time by 75%. Ran Scrum ceremonies, prioritised the product roadmap, recruited and onboarded 4 developers. Active mentoring through pair-programming and structured code reviews.
Designed and drove the web architecture (desktop-to-web migration with Symfony + Angular). Mentored 3 junior developers. Established development standards and DevOps tooling (Docker, GitLab CI).
Development and maintenance of the business application in WinDev for WinLassie — an occupational health, hygiene and safety software solution.

items.title: Tech watch
items.body: Passionate about tech news, I spend part of my free time following trends and innovations. Reading, podcasts, forums: I'm constantly seeking new knowledge and ideas.

items.title: Cooking
items.body: Beyond development, I enjoy spending time cooking — experimenting with new recipes and creating tasty dishes. A source of creativity and relaxation, and sharing a well-prepared meal is always a pleasure.

items.title: Outdoors & hiking
items.body: An outdoor enthusiast, I love exploring new trails on foot, solo or in a group. Walking lets me recharge, enjoy nature and keep an active lifestyle while discovering beautiful landscapes.

footer.line: Designed & coded with care — black background, neon green, lots of coffee.
